specification: KTP-CONFORMANCE Section "Claim Format" and the Terminology entry Substrate Profile
note: Normative downstream requirements for a conformance claim's substrate profile. This repository contains no runtime: these vectors fix the decisions a conformant claim checker produces and define no formula. given/expect are test notation, not wire fields; a profile shown in `given` is one the set carries unless the vector states otherwise.

expect.reason: a claim that names no substrate profile is a claim about no substrate

vectors.reason: A conformance claim MUST name the substrate profile it is made under; one that names none MUST NOT be made.
The specified test IDs of the claimed level are run under the named substrate profile; the profile qualifies the claim and does not change the level.

expect.reason: not a substrate profile this set carries

vectors.reason: A claim that names a substrate profile this set does not carry is not a claim under this specification.
